title: WestJet ordered to pay Canadian couple $2,000 after 16-hour delay blamed on wind
summary_full: After a grueling 16-hour delay, a Canadian couple finally made it to Vancouver, only to find themselves stuck overnight in Regina due to a missed connection. WestJet cited strong winds as the reason for the delay but could not substantiate their claim. Ultimately, the Civil Resolution Tribunal held the airline liable and awarded the couple $2,226.92 for their inconvenience, which included their legal expenses.
